camera_contract.Q_probe: four virtual queries from the sealed source/candidate-only procedure

endpoints.data: the six physical families marked T1 in the seed-137031 cohort, in its recorded order; the full 256 by 256 rectified display-sRGB crop at DTU light 3
endpoints.failure: Keep all registered branches and families. Missing prediction has E=0 for that view and undefined native MAE. Report total coverage/completion and all missing comparisons. A random mean/range requiring three values is undefined when any repeat lacks a comparable endpoint; the remaining repeats still appear individually.
fixed_t1_endpoints: Per subject and condition report independent six-target Y/E and target mean absolute RGB error. Pool counts, then weight objects equally in the study summary.

Compare four methods by AP with prevalence on exactly the same defined views and common support. Report own-support AP, finite coverage, every exact-k matched quota and attainable counts; preserve the historical tie procedure.

Original thresholds are always reported. For each feasible fixed-layout empirical profile, apply its strict score < tau without selection. Evaluate mean low risk group error <=5% and mean coverage >=20% across physical subjects with nonempty acceptance for all. Report per-subject worst error/minimum coverage and actual counts. An infeasible C6 profile has no adapted threshold to test.

label_and_counts.metric: strictly greater than epsilon for float32 mean absolute display-sRGB channel difference to independent registered-camera photograph
label_and_counts.object_masks: only separately verified image-space masks, otherwise N/A

model_and_domain.fixed_layout: Four-method within_new common domain for ranking and matched coverage; full application domain for the original operating point and actual counts.
model_and_domain.selected_layout: Selected-view reconstruction quality is primary. Any descriptive risk uses its released score, with calibration scope outside the fixed layout.

order: admit six fixed physical families without quality-based replacement
one joint M2 from S0 per object
issue five independent choices from the same bounded selector evidence, seal both physical IDs in each trajectory before either candidate photograph
release only chosen candidate images to each trajectory, enforce separate observation ledgers
cold-start the fixed M4 and each selected M4; immutable reuse only on identical ordered inputs, initialization, optimizer seed, and recipe
seal every target prediction, four-method score or terminal failure across ALL six objects and branches before the one joint target opening
apply the frozen evaluation and calibration profiles, retain every scheduled view and failure
endpoints.paired_nbv_endpoint: Within each object, primary contrast is final risk-weighted M4 target MAE minus uniform-geometry M4 target MAE; negative favors risk. Include fixed M4, original M2, all three random choices and their prespecified mean and range. Record new-photo, query/candidate rendering, scoring, optimization and endpoint costs separately. Do not treat repeated random choices as new objects.
endpoints.permission_in_batch_B: directory and camera metadata only, zero T1 source/candidate/target photographs
endpoints.scope: known DTU rig, light, central crop and acquisition task, six named physical subjects; empirical endpoints only
endpoints.stop: single joint opening after every branch is terminal; no retraining, no threshold/profile edits, no competing optimizer or selector after observing outcomes. Record contamination if implementation changes after opening. Report any negative or tied result as observed.

preparation_scope: metadata only; no T1 photograph authorized by this record
